Charts · Live · Replay

Trade with MT5 from Session Terminal.

Your own MT5 prices, every tick, on up to 8 charts. Draw, set alerts and place your trades right on the chart — your EA does the rest. Flip to Replay to practise on any day of the past year.

  • Up to 8 charts, each on its own timeframe, 1 minute to 1 year — plus your own (2m, 3h…)
  • TradingView-style drawing tools and templates; compare up to 3 symbols
  • Press your execution key and click where your stop goes: the order opens in MT5, sized by your EA
  • Drag your SL, TP and break-even lines, or close the trade, right on the chart
  • Alerts on lines, trend lines and zones, sent to your phone
  • Replay any day of the past year with a Replay account — or any of your MT5 trades, with every stop move

Questions

Before you start, the short answers.

Does Session Terminal trade for me or send signals?

No. Every decision is yours, and there are no signals. Session Terminal helps you plan, logs every trade and shows you what’s working. When you want to, you can place and manage your own orders from its charts: they go through your own MT5 and EA to your own broker.

What markets can I trade?

Forex, Indices, Gold, Oil, Crypto and Stocks. All data is synced into the app automatically by our MetaTrader 5 EA. Trading futures or on another platform? Log your trades by hand and enjoy the full journal. Connect the free EA to unlock auto-sync, live charts, alerts and trading from the chart.

Can I place trades from Session Terminal?

Yes, from the Charts tab (Live), once the EA is running in MT5 and you have switched on App trading on its panel there. Press your execution key, click where your stop goes, and your EA places the order with your own risk, break-even, trailing and partial-close settings. Every order is signed, and only your own EA on your own account can act on it. Try it on a demo account first.

How do I connect MT5?

Get the free Minimalist Manager EA from the MQL5 Market and follow Settings → MT5: five steps, about five minutes, and each step ticks itself when your EA checks in. The same code works for all your accounts.

Where do the prices come from, and does MT5 need to stay open?

From your own MT5, through the EA: your broker’s prices, every tick, on any symbol your EA runs, on up to 8 charts from 1 minute to 1 year, plus your own timeframes. So for live prices, alerts and orders, MT5 stays open on your computer or a VPS. Your journal, stats and Replay work any time, on any device.

Can I copy trades to my other accounts?

Yes. The EA’s Trade Copier copies each trade to your other accounts, each at its own risk.

Do I need MetaTrader 5?

It works with or without it. Log a trade by hand in a few seconds — or connect MT5 with the free EA to unlock auto-sync, live charts, alerts and trading from the chart.

Can I use it for a prop firm challenge?

Yes. Add the account with its profit target, daily loss limit and max drawdown. The tracker shows where you stand after every trade and warns you before you get close to a limit.

I am new to trading. Is this for me?

Yes. The Trading Academy has a beginner course that starts from zero and is open on every plan, the free trial included. When you are ready, the ST Method takes you through the rest.

Does it work on my phone?

Yes. It runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer, and you can add it to your home screen like an app. Your journal is the same on every device.

Can I cancel when I want?

Yes. Cancel in Settings in a couple of clicks. You keep everything until the end of the time you have paid for.

The Session Terminal community

Built for the room, not the marketing page.

Session Terminal grew out of a Discord channel, where it became clear that the community's most successful traders were the ones who held themselves accountable for their actions — bias in the morning, review at the close, everything shared in the same channel. The two companion tools come from the same place.

Comes with Session Terminal

Two free companion tools from the same workshop, made to sit alongside the journal — set your charts and your terminal to match how you review.

TradingView · Pine v6

Minimalist indicator

Range zones, a volume profile showing where price traded most, previous day, week and month highs and lows, sessions, market-open gaps and yearly quarters — a clean overlay, free on TradingView and built into the app’s charts.
MetaTrader 5

Minimalist Manager EA

Free on the MQL5 Market. It syncs your trades, streams your live charts and alerts, and carries out the orders you place from the app — with risk sizing, break-even, partials, a trade copier and a max-trades-per-day limit.
